nom: First Aid Beauty Facial Radiance Niacinamide Dark Spot Serum

avis.texte: the pump has been feeling odd for about 2 weeks now, i have only owned this product for about 3/4 maybe. I placed it in my makeup bag and within seconds, the pump had fallen off and the entire bottle nearly emptied out. A complete disappointment and waste of money. deeply regret purchasing and chosing this product out of the other 3 i was looking at.

I absolutely love this stuff! This 1000% took care of the discoloration I've struggled with for years. It's not sticky and leaves skin soft, and didn't flake up with other moisturizers or make up, which I experienced some other dark spots serums.
I used this for several months a couple years ago. It didn't show a change in my age and liver spots. Maybe it has improved since then but I am trying something new now.
I have been using the serum for at least 6 months...almost done with the dropper. I still have not seen my dark spot reduced. I also began using on a recent dark spot due to a scar. Not helpful.

I have tried many creams of this type including Dermatologist prescription cream. I had a tiny sample of this, tried it and this really made a difference. It was like the brown spots went away on 1st try. Kinda weird but great! First Aid products are special! Sometimes expensive but you don't need alot to see they work.
It faded my dark spots within a week or two and it made my face brighter. I have seen that patting it on the skin works best to see results. I would buy again!
I bought this a few months ago and this is my 3rd purchase. I can't run out of this. My dark spots are so much lighter 😍

I used it for 2 weeks and now I have intense redness and even small acnes. Last time I had acnes when I was 15 and this product caused me an acne problem! I just wanted to try another niacinamide serum.

My skin is super sensitive and I started noticing dark melasma spots on my face after I turned 30. This is the only stuff that is gentle enough to use daily and effective enough to see results. You just need to be consistent with it but I'd recommend to anyone.

My friend gave me this at christmas time and I knew I would love it. I have very oily, acne prone skin so I am always applying a Niacinamide serum in the mornings. This products texture is very smooth and may I say a little thicker than a normal serum but in a good way! This goes great with my other skincare products, no pilling. I will be sad once I run out of this because this is a very pricey serum.
Bought this product and after using it for five consecutive days, it caused a major breakout on my face!

I first tried this product through an ipsy bag. I have hyperpigmentation and within days I started noticing results. I have been wanting to buy another bottle and finally have it. I can't wait to continue this journey with the help of FAB

avis.titre: Cleared my (sensitive!!)skin in less than one week
avis.texte: Oh my gosh, I can't state how much I'm in love with this product. I had been using a prescribed cream medication for over two years that couldn't hold a candle to the way my skin cleared up when I incorporated FAB's Niacinamide into my skin care routine. I've been using it now for about two months, and the breakouts that I've had since I was 13 have almost stopped. I was able to quit using my prescription cream, and for the first time in literal years I'm confident enough in my skin to wear minimal concealer instead of heavy cover -up foundations. THANK YOU FAB!
I've tried several products to get rid of the large dark spots caused by sun and age and this one works the best. It also doesn't irritate my sensitive acne prone skin. I highly recommend!

Love this facial serum. I love it for after I wash my face. It's not sticky and feels good when I put it on. I've been using it for a few weeks and have some dark spots on my face and feel like they are starting to lighten!

avis.titre: Noticeable difference within weeks fading dark mar
avis.texte: First Aid Beauty Facial Radiance Niacinamide Dark Spot Serum is game changer for me. Once I learned what it would do for my skin immediately started to incorporate it into my skin care routine and I'm so glad I did. Visibility noticeable glowing skin and less appearance of acne scars!
I can't get over the dropper. That alone makes me not to repurchase this item! The product itself is nice and seems to work.

This product helped me so much with my acne scares. My friend gave it to me as a gift since she had one already cause this one didn't work for her. I don't know if it has to do with my skin type but if you have oily/dry skin use moisturizer afterwards. But my skin went from looking dull/darkish to really clear but I also fixed my skincare routine as well. (I included vitamin C before in the mornings) but I'd definitely recommend this product if your looking for really clear skin and less dullness.
This product delivers results! My skin had some redness and after using it couple of times my skin is in much better condition with less redness each time and smooth even skin tone .

First Aid Beauty's Facial radiance niacinamide dark spot serum works pretty quickly to fade dark spots. Ive been using this serum twice a day along with the heat attatchment from my theraface gadget and its been lightning up my dark spots pretty quickly. Also, this serum is unscented and a little goes a long way. I hope to see a complete fade of these pasky marks pretty soon. Great product.

It's cakey and works BADLY under makeup it peels into those little balls I've given it many chances and it's awful especially for the price and I haven't even noticed a difference But the Pacifica or good molecules those ones are amazing

I just bought another serum and this is my 4th time buying this product. Im a big lover of FAB. Naturally because they are clean and cruelty free. Thats a big deal for me. This serum is very lite weight and absorbs quickly. I have noticed my dark spots have faded a lot more .

avis.titre: I swear dark spots improved overnight
avis.texte: I will never stop using this products it is now a staple in my skincare fr. I'm always scared to try new product bc I'm scared of irritating my sensitive skin but THISSSSSSS *chef kiss* thank you FAB 😭🫶

I have been using this serum for about a month and can really tell a difference. It only does it work to even skin tone, but the formula is very nice and goes on smoothly. It's a bit sticky and I wish the dropper was different, as it doesn't work too well but the product itself is great! I love First Aid Beauty and this is no exception.

Hyperpigmentation has been an issue for me for some time and I haven't had a reaction like I did with this product. I used less than the instructions said to use, but within a day of using this product my skin was red, swollen and noticeably worse-my spots had gotten worse. Days after stopping the use of the Facial Radiance my skin is noticeably dry and red on the spots I applied this serum. I've used many products over the years and have never had a negative reaction such as this.

This serum really was a game changer for me! I use this at night after cleansing and follow with a moisturizer. My skin looks amazing when I am constantly using this. I had ran out and that's when I really realized how big of a difference this product makes. I repurchased and my skin is looking amazing again it brightens and evens my tone. I absolutely love this!

Really like the serum. The only downside I would say is the price. I feel like there are other niacinamide products out there that work just as well for a fraction of the price. If you don't care to spend the cash, it's a great product

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: Really like this product, don't need too use too much which is great because the bottle is tiny. That is my only gripe about it, how small the bottle is.

I love this Serum! I use it under my moisturizer at night, and it has made the sunspots on my forehead disappear. My skin is more even toned, and feels smoother. I have dry skin, but this Serum does not irritate my face or make my skin dryer.
I have very dark and large spots on my face, I have noticed that the spots have lightened a little, I think it has helped me improve the appearance of my dark spots

I have used this for 8 weeks now and have seen a major difference in my skin tone. All my dark sports are fading and I'm so excited. I also add the SPF with it and it's so smooth and doesn't feel like a SPF. They said when lighting I should always use one. I'm so happy with this product I have started 3 friends on it also.

I love this serum so much! Using it makes my skin feel super moisturized and plump. It doesn't make me break out or irritate my skin in any way, and I love that it doesn't have a fragrance. I switched from Paula's choice niacinimide to this one after receiving a sample, because of the added benefit of how it makes my skin feel. Thanks FAB!!
I started using first aid beauty Bc of a product from my Ipsy bag! This stuff is amazing! I'm obsessed with the whole line of products fab delivers!
This niacinamide works great & a little goes a long way so it lasts a good amount of time. It evens out my skin tone and helps with dark areas like my melasma.

I'm a POC who gets hyperpigmentation almost anytime I have a significant breakout. I haven't seen results from niacinamide in the past, but I'd tried and liked a few FAB products, so I gave this a try when it popped up as an option for my Ipsy bag. Some spots that would normally take months to fade have noticeably diminished in just a few weeks of use twice daily (and I'm not someone who does a great job of remembering every time, either). I did break out a little when I first started using it (common with niacinamide from what I've heard). The pigmentation from that outbreak is much less than I usually get. Overall, I was a skeptic, but it turns out that this is the real deal.
I got this in my ipsy but it was completely empty when I opened it!

I just finished up my bottle of serum. This contains Niacinamides and has made my skin look and feel fantastic. I have gotten numerous compliments from random people about how good my complexion looks while using this product. This is dermatologist tested and has no artificial fragrance. The serum is milky white in color.

FABULOUS! I really like First Aid Beauty's Facial Radiance Niacinimide dark spot serum. It is gentle, and you don't need much to get complete coverage. I have some dark spots on my face, and it works well to lighten them up. It has been a noticeable difference. I also use it on the backs of my hands where I have quiet a few dark spots. It works well to lighten them without irritating my skin. I will buy this again. I would also recommend that others try it.

I'm super impressed with this serum. I normally use [product:the-ordinary-niacinamide-10%-zinc-1%-2-oz/-60-ml] under my makeup for oil control. I recently got this in my ipsy bag and I'm sooooo impressed with it! I've been using for about 4 days now daily. It's already evened out my skin tone and as an added bonus- my oil production throughout the day is almost nonexistent. Which is insane because normally by the end of my shift , I've powdered my face 3 times and my makeup is sliding around. Not with this new product. I will def be buying full price when I run out.
this serum didn't do much for me, especially for the price. the dropper was also not great and only picked up a little bit.
I really like it woks good I use this product for About 1 months and is good I noticed the difference between before and after

I know a lot say that it's just a basic niacinimide serum and too expensive for what it's worth. But I love it. It helps my face glow, it cleared out some dark spots and just gives me an overall brightening effect.

So I go this in my Ipsy glam box and I love first aid beauty and this was such a nice serum to receive it is a niacinomide serum that helps reduce the look of hyperpigmentation and gives your skin a even look and it truly has done that for my skin I have noticed such a difference in the past 3 weeks of using My skin it is brighter and my spots have faded the small patches I have heard and there I definitely recommend it's goes on smooth and works well day and night under my makeup or my nighttime routine
Extremely repulsed by this product. It smells like cigarette smoke. It's just awful and I am so disappointed I spent this amount of money on this.

I'm 48 with a little hyperpigmentation. I used the whole bottle applying twice daily. The serum itself is fine but I didn't notice any results as far as fading hyperpigmentation. My biggest complaint is the dropper, it's terrible! Barely pulls any product out of the bottle. Each time I used this I had to try several times before I'd get any product in the dropper. I wound up bypassing the dropper and poured a small amount onto my hand. For the price of this product I'd expect a much better dropper.

i was recommended this by an associate when trying to figure out how to help my redness. never would have thought a dark spot serum would help but it has. beautiful consistency that makes me feel so…pretty? it's expensive but i'd never go without it again.

I love this product for my dark spots because it really like gets rid of them and it's really affective because you could see the results and it is gentle on the skin and I would really recommend this to others if you need help finding a product for your dark spots and yeah￼

This serum has a thicker consistency compared to other ones I've used which made it easy to apply. It wasn't really scented though and smelled slightly like alcohol. I did noticed a difference in my skin though after a few uses!

avis.titre: Hydrates and helps even skin tone but not the best
avis.texte: I have normal skin with hyperpigmentation on my cheeks. This niacinamide is okay, I feel like my skin feels a bit more hydrated after I use it and it helps lighten my dark spots a tad. The consistency of the serum is a little thick and looks milky. If you don't have sensitive skin and you are wanting to lighten dark spots and even your skin tone, I would suggest a vitamin c serum or retinol over this. If your skin is sensitive this could definitely help, however I don't like the fact that first aid beauty doesn't state the percentage of niacinamide and you could get something cheaper from the ordinary that works about the same.

When I purchased this item I really thought that it would be the answer to my prayers.......... I have been using this for quite some time now and I do not see any results if anything I feel like my spots have gotten darker........... This is very disappointing..............................................

avis.titre: Dark spots are a thing of the past!
avis.texte: All I can say is Wow! I have been trying so many dark spot correctors over the past few years and this is the best I have ever tried. I have been using this for a few weeks and all of my old acne scars are barely there anymore. It has also really been helping my age spots and melasma as they are way less noticeable now. I love that it doesn't leave that sticky feeling that a lot of the serums with niacinamide leave. A little goes a long way and this is a must have in my skincare routine now!First Aid Beauty Facial Radiance Niacinamide Dark Spot Serum

I was looking for a good serum for my hyperpigmentation and dark spot removers and this is an amazing niacinamide serum which with continual usage even out your skin tone and gives you a flawless complexion and makes ur skin look good in appearance it can be used both at daytime and nighttime making your skin more eventoned
I use this product twice a day and it cleared my skin so good.

We all need a product like this in our arsenal. I have BAD adult acne and I'm left with so many dark spots. This is a product I never knew I needed until I started using it. My skin is now more even toned and it doesn't irritate

Just got this in my Ipsy box￼. And I'm obsessed with it￼. I could already tell a difference. My least favorite thing is that it has a little bit of a odor. But it does feel very light on the face. ￼￼￼

I used this for a couple months along with using a retinol at night and this really helped fade away dark spots left from new scars. Funny story but not at the time, I tried blade razors from Zephora and shaved my face not that I had to but I thought my makeup application would go on even smoother and I didn't use water or cream stupidly and I broke out in sores and razors bumps on my face that left scars/dark spots. So I needed something that would fade them fast and this def helped!

I never really write reviews for products, but I turned to almost every dark spot lightening products and nothing seemed to work. I turned to this one as my last resort and I am SO glad I tried it out. I noticed a huge difference after about 3 days of adding this into my day and night skin care routine. I feel like it evened out my freckles even (Idk if that's even possible 😂). But my skin feels so supple and soft after applying this into my skin. the skin tone is much more even, as well. I am a HUGE fan of this product and I will definitely continue to purchase ! Only reason for one less star is because I honestly am not a fan of the packaging, I kind of wish it came from a pump bottle or in a squeeze tube. The dropper packaging doesn't allow you to get as much product and will only give you about 3-4 drops, if that. I hate having to dip into the bottle more than once because the serum is thick and sometimes spills out in the side if you're not careful enough putting the dropper back into the bottle straight without touching the opening of the bottle.

avis.titre: Works but my second bottle was broke
avis.texte: Tried this serum for dark spots and when I went through the first bottle I noticed a difference and my spots were going away. I decided to take a little break from it but bought another bottle for other areas. It works but I'm disappointed in my second bottle because there's not a stopper where the dropper goes like my first bottle did so all the product but comes out 😔
I have tried multiple dark spot serum but nothing work on my Face.This serum for me is game changer.Highly recommended

Used this for a while but unfortunately didn't see much improvement on my dark spots. As a serum, it felt nice and absorbed well into my skin but wasn't super effective. I got this as a sample but I wouldn't buy again personally.

I love First Aid Beauty's products, one of my favorites being their cult favorite cleanser. I got this serum in my Allure Beauty Box and it uses some of my favorite ingredients to treat discoloration. Niacinamide not only helps lighten discoloration but it regulates oil production, reduces pore size, protects your skin against environmental aggressors etc Along with Licorice root & Golden kiwi, my skin looks more even and has a healthy glow to it. I highly recommend this serum.

First Aid products are amazing. I recently added this to my regimen to replace a similar product from another brand. This makes my face feel so smooth. I am 51 and I have small, red blotches on the right side of my face. Only niacinamide makes them fade, although they never go away permanently, as long as I use this they stay away. I was using Glow Recipe Dew Drops before but wanted something different. I will definitely repurchase this serum!

avis.titre: This works so well! The bottle is terrible.
avis.texte: I absolutely love this serum. It's gentle and non-irritating even to my hypersensitive skin. It has helped to improve the overall brightness and evenness of my complexion. But the bottle is sooooooo bad. The dropper makes it impossible to get a large amount of product left at the bottom, and you have to tip the bottle to get the last portion (1/8 or so bottle!) out—making it impossible to control the amount you apply. Please fix the packaging so I can keep buying this!

Not a bad product. It has a chalky smell to it- perhaps from whatever mattifying ingredients were used in serum. On that count, it dries down pretty quick- almost too quick for my liking so definitely work in small sections. It's not my holy grail serum but I think other oily skin people will really like this.

avis.titre: Like a magic eraser for your face!
avis.texte: I was skeptical of how well this product would work. I have combination/ance prone skin. I also have acne scarring, dark spots, and redness since high school. Little has been effective address these skin issues so I was like "why not try this?" I was amazed! Using this product regularly, it evens my skin tone remarkably well! It literally is like a magic eraser for my skin. My partner actually thought I was wearing make-up because my skin looks so healthy, even, and clear. I haven't been this happy with my skin in years! So grateful for First Aid Beauty and the Facial Radiance Niacinamide Dark Spot Serum in particular! Highly recommend!

This is the best niacinamide serum I've ever tried! I love First Aid Beauty so much. It makes my skin feel great and really helps my pores and helps to brighten skin. I wish it was a bit cheaper, but it's def worth the price.

After running out of my bottle from TO I wanted to try something different and I am so glad I did. This serum is velvety soft and goes on so smooth. Niacinamide helps improve skins appearance by reducing the look of sun spots, dark spots left behind by acne, hyperpigmentation and discoloration. It also helps with the overall evenness of your skin tone. Niacinamide has been my go to since I got into skincare and it is a staple in my morning routine. It's a great product to have and I have never had any irritation with it out of the few brands I have tried.
I received this item as a gift and most absolutely love it. I got it for my moms and she loves it as well.
I use this in addition to the facial radiance pads. About 3 times a week. Really helps with all the dark spots ive developed this summer!
I use this in addition to the facial radiance pads. About 3 times a week. Really helps with all the dark spots ive developed this summer!
Just wasn't compatible with my skin. I wish niacinamide worked the same miracles for me as it does for so many people. But either it's just not meant to be, or I haven't found the one.

I love the ingredient niacinamide so much. I also love First Aid Beauty. This is a match made in heaven. This has really helped to diminish dark spots and keep my skin glowing, it's honestly my secret weapon and I can't do without it.
My face just looks and feels so good in just a couple weeks of using this

I think I liked this product, nothing mind blowing but I like to have a niacinamide serum in my routine and I definitions would have repurchased but serum is a little too thick for the dropper so a lot of product just sits in the dropper. It needs to be in a pump bottle, then I'd repurchase because this brand works for me.
I have very sensitive skin and this product did not cause any irritation. I feel like using it for just a month has already made my skin look more even and dark spots somewhat lighter

Been using for over a year and it's changed my skin drastically. I have very sensitive skin that's always been red abs irritated no matter what I did, until I started using this! My skin is much more even, never red, and always happy.
Very impressed with what I am seeing after only one week of using, two times per day. Well worth the cost, as I have seen a definite lightening of my sunspots and freckles.
I have been using this for 2 months every night part of my night routine, I have no seen a difference.
First "first aid" product that i used and no difference at all. Disappointed and wasted money.

I received a sample of this via Sephora, so I cannot give any lengthy results from extended use of this product. That being said, I was not satisfied with the texture of this product. Niacinamide is an awesome ingredient, but I've found that First Aid Beauty products always seem to break my skin out. :(

Really liked it for my sensitive skin, only lasted exactly a month. Dropper was awful, didn't do much for dark spots so paying this much for this product didn't reach my expectations nor what they claim in the 4 weeks.

I love FAB products, and this one doesn't disappoint. It's a lightweight, serum type consistency that absorbs really well into the skin. My dark spots are gradually lightening, but I also use a vit c serum as well.

This serum isn't for me. I had really high hopes for this serum, but i noticed everytime i use it it causes breakouts, which i find strange, because i have used nicacinamide products in the past. I've read that higher concentrates pf nicacinamide can cause breakouts, maybe this was the case for me. I love other products from first aid beauty, unfortunately this does not work for me.

avis.titre: It really works (on more than just spots)
avis.texte: I've been using this for a month. I have been taking photos periodically to monitor the changes. After less than two weeks there was significant and noticeable fading of even my darker sun spots. I have very sensitive skin and eyes and am able to use this on my undereye area with zero irritation. I also use it on my chest. I have a weakened immune system and been battling fungal folliculitis for years - this product has virtually eliminated it on my face and chest. I've also seen improvement in skin texture and fine lines. Do your research on niacinamide - it's not a gimmick - it does many great things for the skin. Wish I had known about it sooner!

I finished this and it didn't live up to the hype. For starters, the dropper is awful. Halfway through the bottle I had to just start slowly pouring some in my hands. And obviously that's not ideal because it's hard to control what comes out. Secondly, the formula didn't seem to do anything noticeable. The Ordinary Niacinamide did more for my skin, at a fraction of the price. For me, this just wasn't worth it.

avis.titre: This product works so well. It even got rid of my freckles!
avis.texte: Just use twice a day and started seeing my dark spots and my freckles disappear completely around 2 weeks after I started using it!! Wonderful product!

I have 1 dark spot on my forehead and after using this daily for weeks I saw absolutely no difference. Extremely disappointed because I love so many other products from this company but this one is 100% ineffective.

I have tired different products same of them irritated my skin to much or I break out . But this product I love it I have no problem and going on to second bottle and and I seen a difference and I am very happy , will continue to use .

Does what it claims. My skin has never looked better! I have Oily skin and this has helped keep my oil production down to a minimum and my skin definitely has lightened up a bit. This will not give you overnight results but Istarted seeing results and noticed the changes in my skin after about 2 weeks of use.

The difference in my skin is so amazing since using this product. I have really bad acne scars on the side of my face that only worsen from wearing a mask, and it seemed nothing would work. I tried using this product, and one full bottle later, my skin is practically clear! I've had acne scars for as long as I can remember, so this product has done wonders for my skin! I feel so much more confident without makeup now. Highly highly recommend!
I received this as a sample, not enough to make a noticable difference, but I liked how easy it mixed in with my other products. I'm willing to give it another try for sure.

I saw results after 6 weeks of use! My hyperpigmentations have lightened up a significant amount and my old acne scars have also improved. I will continue to use this hoping my skin continues to improve.
works really great for mt dry sensitive skin and doesn't break me out! it's cleared up my skin so much and the added hydration hydration really nice as well!
I'm 57 and happy with this product and company. I'm so happy my daughter recommend this product

I have been using this for a month and I noticed results the two weeks of using it. This product has been the only product to lighten up a lot of my hyperpigmentation marks from cystic acne I had two years ago. The packaging could be better especially for the price point, they could give more product. The bottle not being see through is a con because you don't know how much product you have left. The serum comes out of the sides of the top when you close it. I use it morning and night but you have to be careful how much you put on bc it peels off when a moisturizer is on top, but it pairs well with the ultra repair cream from first aid beauty.
I have seen a major change with my skin since I've been using this.. omg.. amazing product

I've been using this twice a day for 5 weeks and have noticed no difference in my skin whatsoever. All of my dark spots and melasma are still just as dark as ever, not even the slightest bit of fading. Very disappointed, especially for how expensive this product is. Don't waste your money on this.
I use it twice a day, under sunscreen in the morning and under moisturizer in the evening. Am beginning to see the difference!

I use this at night . First this, then retinoid, then 2 layers of moisturizer. (I use Pond's dry skin cream, and Cerave cream.) I have two red spots, right on the tip of my chin of course, from past hormonal acne. I swear they have lightened at least 30 percent in 10 DAYS of using this. I am AMAZED. I wish it was less expensive. In fact, I almost didn't try it, because a couple years ago I tried the niacinamide serum from the Ordinary, and my face hated it. It made me super dry, tight and flaky. But this seems moisturizing to me. Not enough by itself, because I'm old too, but not drying or irritating at all. I'm very happy with it, and will continue to purchase.

A few age spots of mine are fading, which is nice. Acne scars, too, and I'm 52. Definitely could see less redness on my chin and it even appears the dark circles under my eyes look less dark. I like this much better than Murad. Will definitely buy it again.

I have really bad dark spots from picking my acne (whoops). I've used masks and other products such as murad to help but nothing seemed to work till I found this! My dark spots are significantly better and lighter (see picture) A little goes a long way, I find that If I use too much it makes me break out snd I only use it where I need I don't apply to my full face. The only down side is the packaging. The dropper doesn't work well which I did read in other reviews but I hoped it was just a fluke but those people were right. However the formula is great and worth it!

I've been using this for a bit over 2 weeks, which isn't really long enough to judge these things, esp. for spots as old as mine. But it might be lightening two of the lighter ones, which is better than nothing. I don't think much is going on with two darker ones, but then nothing else has ever worked on them, either (or the other two for that matter), and I've used many serums and the like over many years, at every price point. I'll keep plugging away, and keep my fingers crossed. The 4 stars is a reflection of optimism more than undeniable results.

I've been using this AM and PM for about 2 weeks now and I can already see a difference in lingering dark spots that I've had for months to even years! The texture of my skin also feels smoother. To up the experience I've been using a rose quartz roller on my face after applying to help with some de-puffing. I love FAB and I know I'm going to get results out of this trustworthy brand. Thank you!!

Noticeable brightness and fewer scars on my face! Serum works great. My only complaint is that you have to be careful what products you mix with. I have sensitive skin, so mixing this with the wrong product caused skin irritation. Once I switched up my regimen a bit, the irritation went away. Highly recommend for combination/normal/oily and acne prone skin types!!
2 days in and I already see a difference and the 2nd day pic was in direct sunlight with only sunscreen on! It's shocking how fast and furious this stuff worked!!!

avis.titre: Test on small area for a week - caused breakouts
avis.texte: I've been waiting for First Aid Beauty to come out with a niacinamide face product for a while but unfortunately this serum didn't work for me at all - it caused terrible breakouts, worse than I've had in years. After healing from the first breakout I started using it on a quarter of my face, and while the rest of my face remained clear, the quarter that I was using this serum on broke out terribly again. I can't speak to how it works for its intended purpose because I wasn't able to use it long enough to tell, but I wanted to write a review so that people with sensitive skin can start with a small patch on their face or ideally get a sample first since this is one of First Aid Beauty's pricier products. I hope it works for you!

avis.titre: I wanted to like this product but.....
avis.texte: I had an allergic reaction. My face was completely red and puffy a few hours after use and after a day I had hives. This doesn't mean the product is bad just definitely has an allergen in it.
I'm almost done with my first bottle and I can totally see a difference on my skin! Brighter skin tone, smaller pores! Love it so much definitely buying a new bottle soon.
I really love this serum it's moisturizing and helps with dark spots and preventing breakouts I'm already on my second bottle

With so many products out there, I have little patience for products that don't do what they promise. This DOES. It's powerful stuff.
